summary: Clean up small leftovers in the entity, service, widget and webapp framework code
description:
A few small leftovers found while working on the Java 25 upgrade:

* {{EntityConditionValue.ConstantNumberValue.setModelField()}} logs "Logging to avoid checkstyle issue." at INFO level, under the minilang {{Convert}} class name, every time a condition with a constant number on the right-hand side builds its SQL. It is also the only reason the entity component imports minilang. The method can simply be empty.
* {{LocalDispatcher.getJMSListeneFactory()}} is misspelled. A correctly spelled {{getJMSListenerFactory()}} can be added, keeping the old name as a deprecated method that delegates to it.
* {{HtmlWidgetRenderer.formatBoundaryJsComment()}} is not called anywhere.
* {{cache.properties}} still sets an expiry for the {{widget.menu.classResource}} and {{widget.tree.webappResource}} caches, which no longer exist.
* {{ControlFilter}} has a {{////}} comment that should be {{//}}.

summary: Update or replace the asciidoctor Gradle plugins before Gradle 10
description:
Since the upgrade to Gradle 9 (OFBIZ-13208), every build warns "The StartParameter.isConfigurationCacheRequested property has been deprecated. This is scheduled to be removed in Gradle 10". The call comes from the grolifant library bundled in the {{org.asciidoctor.jvm.convert}} and {{org.asciidoctor.jvm.pdf}} 4.0.5 plugins, not from our build scripts:

{code}
at org.ysb33r.grolifant.loadable.v8.DefaultProjectTools.defaultVersionProvider(DefaultProjectTools.groovy:53)
at org.asciidoctor.gradle.base.AsciidoctorBasePlugin.apply(AsciidoctorBasePlugin.groovy:46)
{code}

Both plugins are held on 4.x ({{build.gradle}} and the {{>= 5}} ignores in {{.github/dependabot.yml}}), because 5.x renamed {{org.asciidoctor.jvm.convert}} to {{org.asciidoctor.jvm}}. Check whether the asciidoctor-gradle 5.x line runs without this deprecation. If it does, migrate to it, adapting the documentation tasks ({{generateReadmeFiles}}, {{generateOfbizDocumentation}}, {{generatePluginDocumentation}}, {{generateAllPluginsDocumentation}}) and dropping the two Dependabot ignores. If no Gradle 10-ready release exists, decide whether to replace these tasks.

h3. Acceptance criteria
* A build with {{--warning-mode all}} shows no {{isConfigurationCacheRequested}} deprecation.
* The documentation tasks still generate the HTML and PDF output.

summary: Remove the unused webdriver-test test case type
description: The webdriver-test element of test-suite.xsd, added by OFBIZ-6618, makes ModelTestSuite load org.apache.ofbiz.testtools.WebDriverTest by reflection, but that class was never part of OFBiz and no test suite uses the element. This removes the element from the schema and its handling from ModelTestSuite, with a note in UPGRADING.md for projects that supplied their own class.

summary: projectmgr demo password data blanks user names and misses one password
description: ProjectMgrDemoPasswordData.xml sets userFullName="" on its six UserLogin records. The data loader stores an empty attribute as null, and this file loads after ProjectMgrDemoData.xml, so the names set there are wiped. The DemoEmployee2 record also spells the password attribute as mcurrentPassword, which the loader ignores, so that user gets no password. This removes the empty userFullName attributes and fixes the attribute name.

summary: UtilHttp.getParameterMap parses a multipart request again instead of reusing the cached multiPartMap
description:
{{UtilHttp.getParameterMap}} parses a multipart request body and stores the result in the {{multiPartMap}} request attribute, but never reads that attribute back. A second call on the same request, for example from a Java event in a chained request, parses the body again; as the stream has already been read, it gets no multipart fields and returns them as missing, without any error. Service events are not affected because {{ServiceEventHandler}} reads the cached attribute, and no trunk flow is known to hit this, so it is hardening rather than a user-visible bug.

h3. Proposal

When {{multiPartMap}} is already set on the request, {{getParameterMap}} uses it instead of parsing the body again.

summary: Stop using Task.project in Gradle task actions (Gradle 10 compatibility)
Move the ecommerce plugin data out of the applications
description:
Following OFBIZ-13867, the applications' seed, demo and test data still point at ecommerce screens, files and URLs. Without the plugin those records are broken, and the content blog's default templates render ecommerce screens. This moves that data into the ecommerce plugin, and moves the two blog templates that content uses into content.

h3. Data to move or fix

Move those two screens into content and point the seed at them; ecommerce keeps working with the content templates.
* *Content seed*: {{ECOM_BLANK}}, {{ECOM_LEFT}}, {{ECOM_RIGHT}} and {{ECOM_LEFTRIGHT}} point at ecommerce decorators and nothing uses them; move them to the ecommerce seed data.
* *Order demo*: the 17 {{ProductStoreEmailSetting}} records of store 9000 with ecommerce body screens, the {{PROMOTIONS}} category {{detailScreen}}, and three promotion texts linking to {{/ecommerce/control/product}}; move them to the ecommerce demo data.

* *Content demo*: {{BLG10001}} reads {{plugins/ecommerce/data/cutekid.jpg}}; move the record to ecommerce or use an image shipped by content.
* *Order test data*: {{OrderTestData.xml}} gives store 9000 an order con

summary: Read use-when context values directly in widget conditions
description:
Several form and sub-hyperlink {{use-when}} conditions are built by expanding context values into the condition text, for example {{use-when=""${invoice.invoiceTypeId}".equals("SALES_INVOICE")"}}. The conditions should compare the context variable directly, so that they do not depend on the content of the value.

h3. Proposed change

Compare the context variable in the condition, for example {{"SALES_INVOICE".equals(invoice?.invoiceTypeId)}}. This covers 36 attributes in 11 widget files in the framework, 8 attributes in 2 plugin files on trunk, and 25 attributes in 7 plugin files on release24.09. Behaviour is unchanged for existing data, apart from a few conditions that were always true or failed on a missing variable: four manufacturing production-run links and five unused fixed-asset fields.

h3. Testing

The change keeps the behaviour of existing conditions for existing data, which is checked by comparing the old and new conditions. The full unit and integration suites pass on trunk and on release24.09.

summary: Remove the ecommerce plugin references from the applications code
description:
Several application screens, templates and classes depend on the ecommerce plugin, so they break, show raw label keys or point to a missing webapp when ecommerce isn't installed. This removes those references or replaces them with neutral equivalents. The ecommerce and other storefront demo/seed data that points at ecommerce will be moved to the plugin in a separate ticket.

h3. Sites to fix

* *product*: {{ProductEvents.tellAFriend}} defaults to {{component://ecommerce/widget/EmailProductScreens.xml#TellFriend}}; the screen should come from the store's email settings with no plugin default.
* *product*: {{CatalogMenus.xml}} links to {{/ecommerce/control/category}} and {{/ecommerce/control/product}} behind an {{isEcommercePresent}} flag that is never set (see OFBIZ-9241), {{ProductScreens.xml}} loads {{/ecommerce/images/productAdditionalView.js}}, and {{EditProductQuickAdmin.ftl}} opens {{/ecommerce/control/product}}; these should use the product store's web site or be removed.
* *order*: {{OrderItems.ftl}} and {{EditOrderItems.ftl}} link to {{/ecommerce/control/product}}; same treatment as the catalog links.
* *order*: {{MiniCart.ftl}} and {{ConfigProductDetai

summary: Receiving the last item of a return without a shipment fails with a NullPointerException
description:
When the last item of a return is received, {{updateReturnStatusFromReceipt}} reads the shipment of each receipt to mark it received, and calls {{shipment.shipmentId}} without checking that the receipt has a shipment. A return received without a shipment, which Facility > Receive Return allows, therefore fails with "Cannot get property 'shipmentId' on null object", the receipt is rolled back and the return never reaches the received status. The minilang version skipped a missing shipment with {{if-not-empty}}; the null check was lost when it was converted to Groovy (OFBIZ-11442).

h3. Proposed change

Use {{shipment?.shipmentId}} so receipts without a shipment are skipped again.

summary: Make UtilCacheTest, EntityEcaUtilConcurrencyTest and ServiceEcaUtilConcurrencyTest reliable
description:
Three unit tests fail intermittently:

* {{EntityEcaUtilConcurrencyTest}} assumes the "main" entity ECA cache is empty when it starts. Gradle reorders test classes between runs, so when an earlier test has already built that cache, the warm-up rebuild does not happen and the test fails. It should clear the cache entry before the warm-up.
* {{UtilCacheTest.testSetExpireCache}} uses a 100 ms expiry, so under load entries can expire before the test checks they were added, and its fixed 200 ms sleep can end before the background expiry has removed them. It should use a longer expiry and wait for the cache to empty instead of sleeping a fixed time.
* {{ServiceEcaUtilConcurrencyTest}} must finish 24,000 lock-serialized calls within 90 seconds, which a loaded machine can exceed. It should run the race for a fixed time instead of a fixed number of calls. Its in-memory resource should also return a URL, so that each call no longer logs an error with a stack trace.

summary: Remove error after test rollback
description:
When you run entity test with `.gradlew 'ofbiz -t component=entity' after the test, entity engine rollback all entity operation. 

During this process, many error appears due to immutable state.

 
!Capture d’écran du 2024-11-12 11-48-09.png!

To solve it, we'll check first is a gv has been set as immutable. In this case we clone it before call the delegator.

Fixed: Remove error after test rollback (OFBIZ-13172)

When you run entity test with `.gradlew 'ofbiz -t component=entity' after the test, entity engine rollback all entity operation. During this process, an error appears due to immutable state on GenericValue rollbacked.

To solve it, we'll check first if a gv has been set as immutable. In this case we clone it before call the delegator.

summary: JMS listeners fail to close cleanly and keep reconnecting after shutdown
description:
h3. Problem
{{JmsQueueListener.close()}} closes its session and connection without null checks, unlike {{JmsTopicListener}}. Closing a queue listener that never connected throws a {{NullPointerException}}, which {{ServiceDispatcher.deregister}} does not catch, so the remaining listeners are not closed either.

{{AbstractJmsListener.onException}} retries {{refresh()}} every 10 seconds until the connection is back, with no way to stop. It keeps running on the JMS provider's thread after the listeners are closed, and a reconnect that succeeds after shutdown leaves an open connection.

h3. Proposed fix
Add the missing null checks to {{JmsQueueListener.close()}}, stop the {{onException}} reconnect loop once the listener has been closed (closing any connection it re-opened), and let {{JmsListenerFactory.closeListeners}} continue with the other listeners when one fails to close.\

summary: Receiving and return screens: post per-row constants once
description:
{{ReceiveInventory.ftl}}, {{ReceiveInventoryAgainstPurchaseOrder.ftl}}, {{ReceiveReturn.ftl}} and {{AddItemsFromOrder.ftl}} repeat values that are the same on every row ({{facilityId}}, {{shipmentId}}, {{datetimeReceived}}, {{currencyUomId}}, {{quantityRejected}}, {{returnId}}) as {{_o_N}} hidden fields, often next to a form-level field with the same value. The receiving screens post 14 to 20 fields per order line and reach Tomcat 11's default {{maxParameterCount}} of 1000 at about 50 to 70 lines.

h3. Proposal

Post these values once as form-level fields. {{ServiceMultiEventHandler}} already falls back to the un-suffixed parameter when a row has none, unless the form sets {{_checkGlobalScope=N}}, which none of these templates does. This removes 30 to 40 % of the fields of each request. Values a row can change, such as {{ownerPartyId}} in {{ReceiveInventory.ftl}}, stay per row.

summary: Remove the PayPal check left in the checkout payment step
description:
{{CheckOutEvents.checkExternalCheckout}} returns "paypal" when the store's PayPal payment setting uses a PayflowPro gateway configuration, and "success" otherwise. The PayflowPro integration was removed in OFBIZ-13446 and nothing seeds that configuration type any more, so the event always returns "success", and the "paypal" response it could still return on an upgraded database is no longer mapped in ecommerce.

This removes {{checkExternalCheckout}} and the event that calls it in the ecommerce {{setPaymentInformation}} request.

summary: Multi forms: cap the requested view size
description:
{{Paginator.getViewSize}} accepts any {{VIEW_SIZE_N}} from the request, so a URL such as {{FindUtilCache?VIEW_SIZE_1=5000}} makes a multi form render thousands of rows, and submitting it posts more parameters than the connector's {{maxParameterCount}} allows. The pager itself offers at most 200 rows.

h3. Proposal

Cap the view size of {{type="multi"}} forms at a new {{widget.form.multi.maxViewSize}} property in {{widget.properties}}, defaulting to 200. List forms are left alone, because several accounting reports and CSV exports set a view size of 99999 on purpose to render all rows, and no multi form or screen including one relies on more than 200.

summary: OFBIZ-6964: Document Scope & Design Revision to support Inter-Facility Transfer Planning in the Constrained MRP
description:
h2. Rationale

A business running a network of facilities, e.g., a plant, a regional distribution center and a few stores, usually replenishes a short Facility from stock the network already holds before it buys or makes anything more. MRP in OFBiz has no notion of that today, so every Facility plans on its own and a store that is short would simply raise a purchase or a production requirement, even when the distribution center next door is holding more than enough.

This ticket takes up from where OFBIZ-7356 ended. The design documented there, and the revision I shared in its last comment, have now been finalized, and the finalized approach is built on top of the constrained MRP engine (OFBIZ-13462), the MRP planning rules (OFBIZ-13628) and the MRP run for a Facility Group (OFBIZ-13630), so the work would continue here, and this ticket supersedes the patch attached to OFBIZ-9506.

In short, a shortfall at a Facility would first get sourced, whole, from the first Facility on its configured lanes that can spare all of it, and only what no source can cover would get made or bought (a transfer itself works at the Product level and never explodes the Bill of Materials), either at the Facility that needs it or, as a residual, at one source on its lanes, i.e., the first one that can make it from its own spare components, else the last one, as per the Planning Rule. Compared with the last comment on OFBIZ-7356, the main differences are that transfer is switched on through the

summary: MRP Run - Constrained (Finite Capacity) Mode
description:
The OFBiz MRP engine currently plans with an infinite-capacity assumption. When it back-schedules a proposed Production Run from its required-by date, it only checks the machine's working calendar i.e., on which weekdays the machine is open and for how many hours, and never checks how much of that time is already taken, either by the existing Production Runs on the shop floor or by the other orders proposed within the same MRP run.

As a result, every proposed order sees every machine as completely free. For example, two runs each needing 6 hours on a machine with an 8-hour day would both get planned onto the same day (i.e., 12 hours of work into an 8-hour window) without any warning, so the plan looks feasible on paper but is impossible to execute, and planners have to find and resolve these overloads manually.

MRP should offer an optional mode to trigger a Constrained Capacity run with finite-capacity planning i.e., treat each machine's daily capacity the way MRP already treats material, as a limited resource that each planned order consumes, so that later orders only get what remains, demand is prioritized by date (the same principle used for material netting), and orders that cannot fit are visibly delayed (flagged Late) or recorded as short (flagged Short), with the Requirement keeping its full quantity, and its peg i.e., the link to the demand it serves, storing the part capacity or material cannot cover, rather than silently overbooked.

Not to mention, the stoc

summary: Fix item group numbering when loading an order into a cart, and remove the unused ShoppingCart copy constructor
description:
{{ShoppingCart.addItemGroup(GenericValue)}}, used by {{loadCartFromOrder}}, moves {{nextGroupNumber}} past a loaded group only when the group number is greater than {{nextGroupNumber}}, not when it is equal. After loading an order whose only item group is {{01}}, the next {{addItemGroup(groupName, parentGroupNumber)}} creates a second group {{01}}, which replaces the loaded group in the cart while the loaded items still refer to the old one. {{nextGroupNumber}} should always end up greater than every loaded group number.

The {{ShoppingCart(ShoppingCart)}} copy constructor, and {{WebShoppingCart(ShoppingCart)}} which wraps it, copy only part of the cart: the order type, sales channel, order and party roles, ship groups, payments, terms, attributes and notes are not copied, so for example a copy of a purchase order cart becomes a sales order. Neither constructor has any caller in the framework, applications or plugins, so they are removed on trunk together with the copy constructors of {{ShoppingCartItem}} and {{ShoppingCartItemGroup}} that only they use. The item group numbering fix also applies to release 24.09; the removal is trunk only.

summary: Move UtilCache onto Caffeine and declare caches in ofbiz-component.xml
description:
UtilCache is built on concurrentlinkedhashmap, which is no longer maintained, and its settings come from a single shared {{cache.properties}}. This replaces the storage with a small cache SPI and a Caffeine implementation, the library's maintained successor already used by OFBiz, while {{UtilCache}} stays the API callers use and a single server behaves as today.

Each component declares its caches with a {{<cache>}} element in its {{ofbiz-component.xml}}, validated by the schema, and a later component can redeclare a cache to override its settings, so {{cache.properties}} is removed. The {{UtilCache}} internals are tidied, and a {{get(key, loader)}} method is added for load-on-miss.

This is the first step of the distributed cache invalidation proposal discussed on dev@ ("[PROPOSAL] Distributed cache invalidation"). It is trunk only, as it changes the cache configuration and parts of the UtilCache API, which will be listed in UPGRADING.md.

summary: The demo store policies text is missing and CMS publish points without content show an error page
description:
The ecommerce policies page only shows the second policies block. {{DemoTreeContent.xml}} is loaded after {{DemoWebSitePublishPointData.xml}} and redefines the {{STORE_POLICIES}} content with an empty {{dataResourceId}}, which clears the data resource that holds the main policies text.

Requesting a publish point that has no data resource and no published content through the {{cms}} request, such as {{/ecommerce/control/cms/POLICY}}, shows the internal error page with the exception message instead of a not found page, because rendering throws "No related content found for publish point".

This keeps the data resource of {{STORE_POLICIES}} in the demo data, and makes the {{cms}} request answer such publish points with the not found handling it already uses for unknown content.

summary: Multi forms: stop posting display-only fields the target does not read
description:
In multi forms every display and hyperlink field is also rendered as a hidden input on each row, because {{also-hidden}} defaults to true. Cache Maintenance ({{ListCache}}) posts 13 fields per row while {{clearSelectedCachesEvent}} reads 2, and across the multi forms bound to {{service-multi}} about 80 per-row fields are not parameters of the target service, so they only count toward Tomcat's {{maxParameterCount}}.

h3. Proposal

Set {{also-hidden="false"}} on display and hyperlink fields that neither the target nor the response view reads, starting with {{ListCache}}, {{ListDelivProductContent}}, {{AddToShipmentPlan}}, {{ListPhysicalInventory}}, {{ManageQuotePrices}} and {{ApproveRequirements}}. The global default stays as it is, because many multi forms carry their primary key, and some services read values such as {{quantity}} or {{defaultQuoteUnitPrice}}, through a display field's hidden copy.

summary: Stop the JMS listener loader thread cleanly when the listeners are closed
description:
{{JmsListenerFactory}} starts a thread that retries loading the configured JMS listeners every 20 seconds until its {{connected}} counter reaches {{loadable}}. {{closeListeners}} stops it only by setting {{loadable}} to 0 from another thread, and {{firstPass}}, {{loadable}} and {{connected}} are plain fields with no synchronization, so the loader thread may not see the change, may sleep for up to 20 seconds after the listeners are closed, and can finish connecting a listener that was just closed. Shutdown always ends with System.exit, so this has no visible effect today, but the factory should not depend on that.

The loader should stop on a thread-safe closed flag set by {{closeListeners}}, be woken from its sleep when the listeners are closed, close again any listener whose connection completes after that, and decide whether to retry from the state of the listeners rather than from counters. JMS listeners are not configured by default, so only setups with a {{jms-service}} server marked {{listen="true"}} are affected.

summary: Multi-row forms: submit only the rows the user selected
description:
Forms that post {{_useRowSubmit=Y}} (27 widget multi forms and about 15 FreeMarker row forms) send every row's fields, but every handler skips rows whose {{_rowSubmit_o_N}} is not set. Selecting 3 rows on a 200-row page of Web Tools Cache Maintenance posts 2603 parameters, of which about 6 are used, against Tomcat 11's default {{maxParameterCount}} of 1000.

h3. Proposal

A {{formdata}} listener in {{OfbizUtil.js}} that, for forms carrying {{_useRowSubmit=Y}}, removes the {{*_o_N}} entries of unselected rows, and does nothing when no row is selected. {{UtilHttp.getMultiFormRowCount}} uses the highest row index, so gaps are already handled.

h3. Required fixes in the same change

{{ShoppingCartEvents.quickInitPurchaseOrder}} reads {{supplierPartyId_o_0}}, {{billToCustomerPartyId_o_0}}, {{orderId_o_0}} and {{agreementId_o_0}}, {{ShoppingCartHelper.addToCartBulkRequirements}} reads {{facilityId_o_0}}, and the Quick Purchase Order link of the approved requirements page copies the order ID into row 0 only, whether or not row 0 is selected. These values should come from the first selected row or from form-level fields.

summary: Make email address verification work and mark verified addresses
description:
The email address verification services added in 2007 were never wired up: nothing creates a verification, no request handles the link since the cmssite demo request was removed in 2008, and {{verifyEmailAddress}} only checks that the hash exists without recording anything. The token is also an MD5 of a 64-bit random number stored in clear, and a second request for the same address fails.

This makes verification work for an email address a party already has. {{sendEmailAddressVerification}} mails a link when the product store has a {{PRDS_EMAIL_VERIFY}} email setting, the token is 256 random bits of which only the SHA-256 is stored, a resend replaces the pending token, and {{verifyEmailAddress}} consumes the token and sets {{PartyContactMech.verified}}. Changing an address leaves it unverified. ecommerce sends the link after registration, after adding or changing an email address and from a Resend button on the profile, and maps the verification request. Nothing is blocked for unverified addresses.

summary: XML Data Export: select all entities or a package without one parameter per entity
description:
Web Tools XML Data Export renders one {{entityName}} checkbox per entity, about 1200 in a trunk build with plugins, and "Check All" reloads the page with every non-view entity ticked. Exporting everything therefore posts about 1200 parameters, over Tomcat 11's default {{maxParameterCount}} of 1000, so it only keeps working because OFBIZ-13727 raised the connectors to 10000, and the count grows with every entity a plugin adds.

h3. Proposal

Add an entity selection choice to {{XmlDsDump.ftl}}: all entities, all entities including views, by entity package, or the checkboxes below. {{XmlDsDump.groovy}} resolves the first three from the model reader, the same list the page already shows, so the request carries one value instead of one per entity, and "Check All" becomes the "all entities" choice. The existing {{entityName}}, {{preConfiguredSetName}} and {{entitySyncId}} parameters keep working.

last_comment.author: Mridul Pathak
last_comment.text:
The patch doesn't include the "all entities including views" option from the description. A view entity holds no data of its own: its rows come from the member entities, which are already exported, and are mostly there for reporting. A view's export also can't be imported back, since a view can't be stored. Both new choices, all entities and the entities of the selected packages, therefore leave views out, as Check All and the directory export already did. A view can still be ticked individually if someone really needs its rows.

summary: Remove the application references to the projectmgr plugin
description:
Applications should not depend on plugins, but order, party and sfa still reference projectmgr objects. The order view screen includes the {{projectAssoOrder}} form from {{component://projectmgr/widget/forms/ProjectForms.xml}}. The party communication event screens and menus check whether projectmgr is installed and then load its {{GetLastRequestAssignment.groovy}} script and {{EditCustRequest}} form. The sfa controller maps an {{updateTaskAssigment}} request to the projectmgr-only service of that name, and nothing links to it.

This removes those references. projectmgr already lists a project's orders on its own Orders tab and creates requests from communication events on its own request screen, so no function is lost.

summary: Regression of OFBIZ-10506: hasLoggedOut stays null after password login, user is logged out on next request when header login is enabled
TemporalExpression subclasses compute hashCode from fields that equals ignores
description:
The base {{TemporalExpression.hashCode}} includes the expression {{id}} and {{sequence}}. Each subclass in {{TemporalExpressions}} (DateRange, DayInMonth, DayOfMonthRange, DayOfWeekRange, Difference, Frequency, HourRange, Intersection, MinuteRange, MonthRange, Substitution, Union) overrides {{equals}} to compare only its own fields, but starts its {{hashCode}} from {{super.hashCode()}}. Two expressions with different IDs and the same content are therefore equal but usually have different hash codes, which breaks the {{equals}}/{{hashCode}} contract.

No current code keeps temporal expressions in hash-based collections (members are held in {{TreeSet}}s ordered by {{compareTo}}), so there is no visible effect today, but any future {{HashSet}} or {{HashMap}} use would treat equal expressions as different. The fix is to compute each subclass hash code from the same fields its {{equals}} compares.

summary: secretshub tests do not compile with the Java 25 lossy-conversions warning
description:
{{BitwardenSecretsProviderTest}} flips a ciphertext byte with {{ct[0] ^= 0xFF;}}, an implicit int to byte compound assignment that Java 25 reports as a {{[lossy-conversions]}} warning, so {{compileTestJava}} fails under {{-Werror}} when the secretshub component is enabled. The plugin is disabled by default, which is why neither CI nor BuildBot reports it.

h3. Proposed change

Cast the constant: {{ct[0] ^= (byte) 0xFF;}}.

summary: Remove the getJs / multi-block inline script extraction
description:
Templates included with {{multi-block="true"}} have their inline {{<script>}} blocks stripped at render time, stored in a per-session cache ({{ScriptLinkHelper}}) and served back through one extra {{getJs}} request per template. This was added in OFBIZ-11686 and OFBIZ-11706 for Content Security Policy compliance, but the policy is still report-only and cannot be enforced while inline event handlers and {{javascript:}} URLs remain, so the mechanism brings no benefit today.

It also has defects: the cache is a static unsynchronized map shared by all request threads, it holds 250 sessions and 15 scripts per session so scripts can be evicted before the browser fetches them, each script can be read only once so a reload or retried request gets an empty 404, and every such template is re-parsed and re-serialized with Jsoup.

h3. Proposed change

Remove the extraction and the {{getJs}} / {{js}} requests so inline scripts run where they appear in the page, and remove the {{multi-block}} uses. The attribute stays in {{widget-screen.xsd}} as a deprecated no-op so existing custom screens still validate. A CSP nonce can be added later as separate work.

summary: MRP Requirement Aggregation by Day or Week
description:
h2. Rationale

With OFBIZ-13788, the demands of one Product due in the same bucket get planned as one batch, so a Product gets one Requirement per batch rather than one per demand. What it doesn't cover is the same component needed by different Products, e.g., if twenty skateboard models use the same wheel, a week of orders for all twenty would still raise a purchase Requirement for that wheel per batch, and a buyer would have to put them together by hand before placing the week's order. The same goes for the transfer Requirements of one store from one DC, where its orders for the same Product get planned one after the other.

Most planning tools offer this as period lot sizing, i.e., the needs of an item at a site over a day, a week or N of them get covered by one order, dated by the first need in the period. With the pegs of OFBIZ-13462 (RequirementPegging), a Requirement doesn't have to serve a single demand to stay traceable, so the purchase and transfer Requirements of one Facility, Product and bucket could get proposed as one Requirement, while each demand it serves keeps its own peg, with its own quantity, need date, Late, Short and constraints.

Point to note here is that the engine would aggregate while it plans, and would write the aggregated Requirement directly, i.e., the Requirements it replaces never get written, and so there is nothing to map back to, as the pegs already say which demand each part of a Requirement is for. Here, the engine plans demand by

summary: OFBIZ-13462: MRP Demand Aggregation by Day or Week
description:
h2. Rationale

OFBIZ-13462 plans order by order, and every demand gets a Requirement of its own, even for the same Product (its R2a), which is what lets every batch get traced to the order it serves. The price of it is a setup per Requirement and many more rows than a planner would make by hand, e.g., three Sales Orders for the skateboard due on the same day would become three Production Runs on AMC, each one paying its own 15 minutes of setup, and three of everything below them. Writing those Requirements is also where a run spends most of its time.

With the pegs of OFBIZ-13462 (RequirementPegging), a Requirement doesn't have to serve a single demand any more to stay traceable, as each demand it serves gets a peg of its own, with its own quantity, need date, Late, Short and constraints. So the demands of one Product due on the same day, or in the same few days or weeks, could get planned together as one batch, while every one of them stays visible.

Point to note here is that merging never delays the higher-ranked demand, as a batch gets planned at the place of its most urgent member in the ladder of the Planning Rule, and inside the batch supply goes by that ladder first, so with a shortfall, the lowest-ranked members go short first. What it does allow is that a lower-ranked member, e.g., a Forecast, rides at its batch's place, and so can use capacity before the higher-ranked demand of another Product, which is the usual effect of period lot sizing, so a rule that ca

summary: MRP Constrained Run - Component Substitution
description:
h2. Rationale

When the Constrained mode (OFBIZ-13462) plans a demand, and a component of its Bill of Materials is short at the Facility, the only ways it has to cover the shortfall today are a transfer from another Facility (OFBIZ-13666), or making or buying the component. In practice, a plant would often have another component on the shelf which can be used in its place, e.g., a wheel from a second supplier, or a 2 x 500 ml pack in place of a 1 L bottle, and a planner would rather use that stock than wait for a Purchase Order or move goods between Facilities.

OFBiz already lets us define such substitutes with ProductAssoc of type PRODUCT_SUBSTITUTE, and this ticket would let the Constrained engine use them, i.e., when a component is short, the run would cover the shortfall from the spare stock of its substitutes at the same Facility, before it searches the transfer lanes or makes or buys the component. It is switched on per Facility through its planning rule (OFBIZ-13628).

Point to note here is that only components get substituted, and not the Product a Sales Order or Forecast asks for, as substituting what a customer ordered is a decision taken at order promising in other planning systems as well, and not something MRP should assume silently.
h2. Requirements
 * A planning rule should be able to switch component substitution on for the Facilities planned under it, and it should stay off by default.

summary: OFBIZ-13462:  MRP Run for a Facility Group
description:
h2. Rationale

A business with a plant and several warehouses currently has to run MRP once per Facility, and nothing ties those runs together. Run MRP does offer a Facility Group, which looks like a network run but in fact it is not, as it plans only the group's first WAREHOUSE and first PLANT as a single pairing and ignores every other member.

Also, the MRP engine cannot safely plan several facilities one after another, because each run deletes the MRP events of every Facility (and not just its own) and then plans from whatever events it finds.
h2. Requirements
 * Choosing a Facility Group should plan every member, each one exactly as it would get planned on its own.
 * Each member should get its own plan, identifiable on its own, and the plans of one run should be grouped by a cycle id.
 * Every Requirement a group run proposes should record the Facility Group, so that all the Requirements of one run can get found together, whichever member they were planned for.
 * The run should replace only its members' previous plans, and all or nothing i.e., if any member fails, every member would keep its previous plan.
 * Members should get planned in a fixed and repeatable order.
 * By default, each member should plan in its own MRP Mode and under its own default Planning Rule, else under the default rule of the Facility Group being run, though a run could override either of them, with a rule picked for the whole run or for one member.

summary: OFBIZ-13462: MRP Planning Rules
description:
h2. Rationale

When MRP plans against finite machine capacity, demands would compete for the same machine hours and the same stock, and the order in which they get served decides who gets what. That order is essentially a business policy, and it varies from business to business and even from plant to plant, for example:
 * *Which kind of demand should be served first* i.e., Customer Orders, parts for work already on the shop floor, rebuilding Safety Stock, or Forecast. One plant might like to top up its buffer before serving the Forecast, whereas another one might prefer it the other way round.
 * {*}Whether a dated demand should go ahead of an undated one{*}, within the same kind of demand.
 * *Whether a machine can stand idle to keep the priority.* When an urgent order is waiting for its parts, less urgent work could use the machine in the meantime. Some plants are fine with that, whereas others would rather keep strict priority and accept the idle time.

If these choices are hardcoded, then any change in them would need a developer. And once they start differing, a plan on its own can no longer tell which choices produced it.
h2. Requirements
 * Planners should be able to define these choices as {*}data{*}, grouped under named {*}Planning Rules{*}.
 * Any rule should be usable at any Facility, and each Facility should be able to name {*}its own default rule{*}, which every unattended (scheduled) run of that Facility would use, while the planner could still pick a

summary: OFBIZ-13462: MRP - Requirement Pegging
description:
h2. Rationale

OFBIZ-13462 plans order by order, and every Requirement it proposes would carry the Late and Short flags, the unmet quantity and the ideal date of the demand it serves. That works as long as a Requirement serves exactly one demand, but it doesn't hold any more once a Requirement serves more than one, e.g., the demands of one Product planned together as a batch (OFBIZ-13788), or a distribution center's Requirement serving the transfer Requirements of the stores (OFBIZ-13666), as a single set of flags on the Requirement cannot say which of the demands is late, or on which of them the shortage falls. Also, what held a demand back, i.e., the machine, the part or the calendar, would be named only in the run's messages, so it is gone once the screen is closed.

This sub-task moves those fields off the Requirement onto a peg, i.e., one row per Requirement level per demand it serves, and records under each peg every constraint that held that demand back at that level.
h2. Requirements
 * Every Requirement an MRP run proposes, Constrained or Unconstrained, should be traceable to each demand it serves, at every level of the Bill of Materials.
 * Late, Short, the unmet quantity and the ideal date should be recorded per demand, and not per Requirement.
 * Each demand should say what held it back, if anything, i.e., every constraint it met at each level, each with the reason and the machine, Product or calendar behind it, and which one of them is the main one.

summary: Persisted job stays SERVICE_RUNNING forever when its next run cannot be computed
description:
{{PersistedServiceJob.init()}} marks the job SERVICE_RUNNING and then computes the next run from the job's RecurrenceInfo or temporal expression. {{GenericServiceJob.exec()}} calls {{init()}} outside its error handling and {{AbstractJob.run()}} only catches {{InvalidJobException}}, so any other exception thrown at that point (for example a UNION temporal expression without child expressions, or a recursive one) ends the job thread: the service is not run, the stack trace only goes to stderr, and the job stays SERVICE_RUNNING until the instance is restarted. A failure to store the next recurrence leaves the job in the same state.

The fix marks the job as failed when computing or storing its next run fails after it was marked running, and makes {{AbstractJob.run()}} log any unexpected exception to the OFBiz log.

summary: Uploads whose MIME type has no file extension mapping are checked as .tmp files
description:
{{attachUploadToDataResource}} builds the stored path from the {{FileExtension}} row of the uploaded file's MIME type, and {{DataServices.createFileMethod}} and {{updateFileMethod}} give the temporary file they validate the extension of that path. When the MIME type has no {{FileExtension}} row, the path has no extension, the temporary file gets the default {{.tmp}} suffix, and {{SecuredUpload.isValidFile}} rejects it because {{tmp}} is not in the allow-list. A rejected {{.xlsx}} upload is therefore reported as "File extension [.tmp] is not in the allow-list for file type [All]", and an upload of an allowed type whose MIME type is not mapped, for example {{csv}}, {{m4a}}, {{aac}}, {{mkv}} or {{webm}}, is rejected as well.

h3. Proposed change

When the stored path has no extension, give the temporary file the extension of the uploaded file name, which has already been checked by {{isValidFileName}}, so that the allow-list and content checks run against the real extension and the message names it.

summary: Remove the unused sendTelecomMessage service and fix it on release24.09
description:
The {{sendTelecomMessage}} service in {{framework/common}} looks up the gateway service through the {{ProductStoreTelecomSetting}} entity and records the message as a {{CommunicationEvent}}. Since the msggateway plugin was removed from trunk, nothing implements {{sendTelecomMessageInterface}} or calls the service there, and it is framework code that depends on an applications entity.

The service also has bugs on both branches:
* it checks the {{createCommunicationEvent}} result instead of the gateway result for {{response}}, so the gateway response is never stored in the communication event note;
* it throws a NullPointerException when the {{ProductStoreTelecomSetting}} has no {{telecomCustomMethodId}};
* its messages name {{ProductStoreEmailSetting}} and {{sms.notifications.enabled}} instead of {{ProductStoreTelecomSetting}} and {{telecom.notifications.enabled}}.

On trunk, the service, its interface, {{TelecomServices}} and the {{telecom.notifications.*}} and {{defaultFromTelecomAddress}} properties are removed, with an upgrade note. The telecom entities and seed types are kept, so existing data still loads.

On release24.09, where the msggateway plugin still implements the interface, the three bugs are fixed.

summary: Leave generated secret keys out of Gradle build cache keys
description:
The generateSecretKeys task writes random values for login.secret_key_string and security.token.key into framework/security/config/security.properties, and for ofbiz.admin.key into start.properties. Both files are part of the main resources, so every setup that has run loadAll or generateSecretKeys gets its own build cache keys. As a result, test, checkstyleMain, checkstyleTest, codenarcTest and compileTestGroovy cannot reuse cached results between setups: across CI runs (loadAll generates new keys each time) or between CI and developer machines. This would limit the benefit of enabling the Develocity remote build cache (PR #1033).

The proposal is to add a Gradle runtime classpath normalization rule to build.gradle that ignores these three properties when computing cache keys. Their values do not affect those tasks' outputs, and any other change to the files would still invalidate the cache. Key generation and rotation for real installations would stay unchanged, and no fixed keys would be added.

summary: RecurrenceRule throws NullPointerException when the interval is empty
description:
{{RecurrenceRule.load()}} validates the rule with {{rule.getLong("intervalNumber") < 1}}. The {{intervalNumber}} field is nullable, so a rule with no interval (for example one created through webtools or an entity import) fails with a NullPointerException instead of being loaded. The NullPointerException is not the declared {{RecurrenceRuleException}}, so {{RecurrenceInfo}} does not handle it and it reaches its callers, such as persisted job scheduling.

{{getInterval()}} in the same class already treats an empty interval as 1, which is also the iCalendar default. The fix makes the validation use {{getInterval()}}, so an empty interval means 1 and a zero or negative interval is still rejected.

summary: Inventory issuance tests fail after 2026-12-31 because the test fiscal year expires
description:
The inventory issuance test data ({{applications/manufacturing/testdef/data/InventoryIssuanceTestData.xml}}) defines the {{II_FISCAL_YEAR}} CustomTimePeriod with a thruDate of 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01, {{postAcctgTrans}}, called through the {{assignInventoryToWorkEffort}} SECA, cannot find a fiscal period for {{II_COMPANY}}. The shared transaction is then marked for rollback and the issuance fails, so 19 of the 36 tests in {{inventoryissuancetests}} fail.

The fix removes the thruDate so the test fiscal year is open-ended, which {{findCustomTimePeriods}} already supports.

summary: Remove legacy webtools developer pages
description: Three groups of webtools developer pages have no users and some are already marked as not working: the Apple EOModel export, the JSP entity tools (model and MySQL writers, drop-table pages) and a set of 2006 test endpoints. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes them from trunk. The live webtools tools are not affected.

summary: Fix the schema validation errors logged at start-up by three REST API files and the lucene component
description:
{{framework/testtools/api/testruns.rest.xml}} and the example plugin's {{example.rest.xml}} and {{product.rest.xml}} still declare {{<api path="...">}}, which OFBIZ-13440 replaced with the required {{apiGroupPath}} attribute. The {{path}} value is ignored and the APIs fall back to the default {{api}} group, so they work at {{/rest/api/...}}, but every start logs "Attribute 'apiGroupPath' must appear on element 'api'" for each file, and some service descriptions, Javadoc and the REST API documentation still show the old {{/rest/testtools/...}} and {{/rest/example-product/...}} URLs. Separately, {{plugins/lucene/ofbiz-component.xml}} declares its {{<container>}} before its {{<webapp>}}, which the component schema doesn't allow, and logs "Invalid content was found starting with element 'webapp'" at every start.

h3. Proposed change

* Replace {{path}} with {{apiGroupPath="api"}} in the three REST API files, which keeps their current URLs and authentication.
* Correct the endpoint URLs in the testtools service descriptions and Javadoc and in the REST API documentation.
* Move the lucene {{<container>}} after the {{<webapp>}}.

summary: Do not trust the RMI certificate for all outbound TLS connections
description:
The service component declares {{config/rmitrust.jks}} as a truststore, so its certificate is added to the trust anchors that {{SSLUtil}} uses for every outbound TLS connection, including the HTTPS calls made through {{URLConnector}} and {{HttpClient}} by payment gateway and shipping carrier integrations. The private key for that certificate is shipped in {{framework/base/config/ofbizrmi.jks}}, and the JDK does not check the expiry date of a trust anchor, so a server certificate signed with that key is accepted for any host name.

The fix removes the {{rmitrust}} keystore declaration and {{rmitrust.jks}} from the service component. An installation that runs the RMI dispatcher over SSL has to put its own RMI certificate in a truststore, which it already needs to do because the shipped RMI key is public.

Trunk is not affected: RMI support, including these keystores, was removed with OFBIZ-13816.

summary: Remove the unused simple-method-test test case type
description:
The {{<simple-method-test>}} element of the test suite definitions runs a minilang simple-method as a test case through {{SimpleMethodTest}}. No testdef in ofbiz-framework or ofbiz-plugins trunk uses it any more since the minilang tests were converted to Groovy, and the only example left in the testtools documentation points to {{AutoAcctgTransTests.xml}}, which no longer exists. {{SimpleMethodTest}} is also the only main-code user of Spring: it passes {{MockHttpServletRequest}}, {{MockHttpServletResponse}} and {{MockServletContext}} to the simple-method, which is why {{spring-test}} and {{spring-web}} are {{implementation}} dependencies and ship in the runtime classpath. A simple-method exposed as a service can still be tested with {{<service-test>}}.

h3. Proposed change

* Remove {{SimpleMethodTest}}, the {{simple-method-test}} branch of {{ModelTestSuite}} and the {{simple-method-test}} element of {{test-suite.xsd}}.
* Remove the {{simple-method-test}} example from the testtools documentation.
* Move {{spring-test}} and {{spring-web}} to {{testImplementation}}, since only unit and integration tests under {{src/test}} still use the Spring servlet mocks.
* Add an UPGRADING.md note for custom components that still declare {{<simple-method-test>}}.

h3. Release branch applicability

Trunk only. On release24.09, {{<simple-method-test>}} is still used by testdefs in the framework, applications and plugins.

summary: Move the Tika PDF parser to the test dependencies and remove the unused SecuredUpload.recursiveParserWrapper method
description:
h3. Problem
The {{tika}} bundle puts {{tika-parser-pdf-module}} on the runtime classpath, with {{tika-parser-xmp-commons}}, {{pdfbox-tools}} and {{bcjmail-jdk18on}}. The main code only uses the {{Tika}} facade's {{detect()}} from {{tika-core}}, and the PDF module registers no detector (only a {{Parser}} and a {{Renderer}}), so it does not change detection. Its only users are {{WidgetMacroLibraryTests}}, which parses the rendered PDF, and {{SecuredUpload.recursiveParserWrapper}}, a private method that has never been called since it was added in OFBIZ-12080 (its only call is commented out).

h3. Fix
* Depend on {{tika-core}} directly and move {{tika-parser-pdf-module}} to {{testImplementation}} ({{ofbiz --test}} runs with the test runtime classpath), removing the {{tika}} bundle.
* Remove {{recursiveParserWrapper}}, its commented-out call and its imports.
* Add constraints keeping {{bcpkix-jdk18on}} and {{bcutil-jdk18on}} on the {{bcprov-jdk18on}} version: {{bcjmail-jdk18on}} was what kept them on 1.86, and without it {{utils-mail-dkim}} would bring them back to 1.78.1 next to {{bcprov-jdk18on}} 1.86.

The runtime classpath loses only those 4 jars, with no other version change, and the test runtime classpath is unchanged.

h3. Release branch
Not applied to Release 24.09, which also depends on the full {{tika-parsers}} set, whose container detectors change {{Tika.detect()}} results; reducing it there would change upload type detection.

summary: Limit the assetmaint permission fallback for party and catalog checks to view access
description:
The assetmaint plugin defines service ECAs on {{partyBasePermissionCheck}}, {{catalogPermissionCheck}}, {{facilityGenericPermission}}, {{workEffortGenericPermission}} and {{fixedAssetPermissionCheck}} that rerun the check with {{ASSETMAINT}} as the primary permission whenever the original check fails. A user with {{ASSETMAINT_UPDATE}}, for example, therefore passes the {{PARTYMGR_UPDATE}} and {{CATALOG_UPDATE}} checks, which lets them merge parties with {{linkPartyRecord}} or edit products and catalogs, beyond what asset maintenance needs.

Asset maintenance screens only look up parties and catalog data, so the party and catalog fallbacks should apply to the {{VIEW}} action only. The facility, work effort and fixed asset fallbacks stay, since the asset maintenance screens create and update those records.

A default installation is not affected: {{ASSETMAINT}} permissions are only seeded to administrator groups, and the demo technician group has no members. The same ECAs exist on release24.09.

summary: Remove the unused log4j-web dependency
description:
h3. Problem
{{dependencies.gradle}} declares {{runtimeOnly libs.log4j.web}} (with a {{//???}} comment). log4j-web is the {{javax.servlet}} module of Log4j: its {{Log4jServletContainerInitializer}} is only registered in {{META-INF/services/javax.servlet.ServletContainerInitializer}}, which Tomcat 10 and later do not read, and its {{web-fragment.xml}} declares nothing but an ordering. It has therefore done nothing since the Tomcat 10 upgrade (OFBIZ-12989), while Log4j 2 keeps being configured once for the whole JVM.

h3. Fix
Remove the dependency and its version catalog entry. The Jakarta equivalent, {{log4j-jakarta-web}}, is not added: it would enable a per-webapp Log4j lifecycle that OFBiz, running an embedded Tomcat with a single Log4j configuration, does not need.

summary: Restrict FORM_COMBINED data resource rendering to deployed form definitions
description:
h3. Problem
When a data resource uses the FORM_COMBINED template type, DataResourceWorker.renderDataResourceAsText builds the form from XML read out of the data resource's own text. Form XML can carry actions and ${groovy:} expressions, so the stored text decides what runs during rendering. The SCREEN_COMBINED type was restricted to deployed component:// screen locations in #1846, but FORM_COMBINED was left as is.

No FORM_COMBINED template type is seeded, and creating one requires CONTENTMGR_SUPER, so a default installation does not reach this code.

h3. Proposed change
Render a FORM_COMBINED data resource only when it is a URL_RESOURCE whose objectInfo is a component:// form location, loaded with FormFactory.getFormFromLocation, as SCREEN_COMBINED already does.

summary: Restrict the Alfresco Maven repository to the org.activiti group
description:
{{build.gradle}} declares the Alfresco repository, added with the Tomcat 10 upgrade (OFBIZ-12989) for {{org.activiti:activiti-juel-jakarta}}, without any content filter. Gradle therefore looks up every {{org.activiti}} module on Maven Central first, where none of them is published (7 HTTP 404s for {{activiti-juel-jakarta}}, its parent POMs and the imported {{activiti-api-dependencies}} BOM), and looks up on Alfresco every module that is missing on Maven Central, whatever its group. This adds needless requests to Maven Central, which already rate limits OFBiz builds (HTTP 429).

h3. Fix
Declare the Alfresco repository with {{exclusiveContent}} filtered on the {{org.activiti}} group, so that {{org.activiti}} modules are only looked up on Alfresco and Alfresco is only used for them. The other dependencies, including the Spring Boot BOM imported by {{activiti-parent}}, keep coming from Maven Central.

h3. Release branch
Not applied to Release 24.09, which has a different set of unfiltered repositories (Restlet, Atlassian, an artifact-only Maven Central for BIRT and Clojars) and no Alfresco repository; changing the build configuration of the release branch is not worth the risk for fewer lookups.

summary: Harden the passport GitHub login: token logging, client secret in the URL and username matching
description:
The passport plugin's GitHub login, once a store has an OAuth2GitHub configuration, has three weaknesses in {{GitHubEvents}}:

* It logs the whole token response from GitHub, including the user's access token, at INFO level.
* It sends the client id, client secret and authorization code in the query string of the token request instead of the request body.
* It matches GitHub users to OFBiz user logins on the GitHub login name ({{UserLogin.externalAuthId}}). GitHub users can rename themselves and freed names can be taken by someone else, who then logs in to the previous owner's OFBiz account.

h3. Change
* Stop logging the token response.
* Send the token request parameters as a form body.
* Store GitHub's numeric user id in {{externalAuthId}} for new users and look users up by it.
* Compare the stored {{envPrefix}} field rather than a field named {{ENV_PREFIX}}, which made every GitHub login rewrite the {{GitHubUser}} row.
A user linked by login name before this change is moved to the numeric id the next time they log in.

The GitHub login is not wired into any page by default; the redirect and response requests are mapped in ecomseo but only work once client credentials are configured. This applies to release24.09 only; the passport plugin was removed from trunk in OFBIZ-13814.

summary: Cross-subdomain sessions do not work: the session cookie never gets the cookie domain
description:
With {{enable-cross-subdomain-sessions}} set to {{true}} in {{framework/catalina/ofbiz-component.xml}}, the session cookie is still set without a {{Domain}} attribute, so the session is not shared between subdomains. {{CrossSubdomainSessionValve}} looks for the session cookie in the request cookies, which a new session does not have, so it never replaces the cookie Tomcat adds to the response (it has been the case since the Tomcat 7 upgrade). Once it does, the request has no delegator yet when the valve runs, which throws a NullPointerException, and Tomcat's RFC 6265 cookie processor rejects the computed {{.example.com}} domain because of its leading dot. Lastly, the session id change done at login to prevent session fixation (OFBIZ-10420) creates a new session cookie after the valve has run, so the session would lose its domain at login anyway.

h3. Fix
Replace the valve with a cookie processor, set on each webapp context when {{enable-cross-subdomain-sessions}} is {{true}}, which adds the domain ({{cookie.domain}} in {{url.properties}} or, when empty, the last two parts of the server name, without a leading dot) to the session cookie. Since Tomcat generates every session cookie header with the cookie processor of the context, this covers new sessions as well as session id changes.

h3. Release branch
Release 24.09 has the same valve and the same login session id change, on Tomcat 9 which uses the same RFC 6265 cookie processor, so the fix applies there too.

summary: LDAP login gives auto-created users FULLADMIN by default
description:
The ldap plugin creates an OFBiz user on a directory user's first LDAP login. With the shipped configuration ({{plugins/ldap/config/ldap.xml}}), and with the fallback values in {{AbstractOFBizAuthenticationHandler}}, that user is linked to the {{admin}} party and added to the {{FULLADMIN}} security group, so every directory account becomes a full administrator. The LDAP login is not wired into any webapp by default and only runs after a deployer edits the login request maps as described in {{SingleSignOn.adoc}}, which also gives {{FULLADMIN}} as the example group.

h3. Change
* Ship empty {{AutoPartyId}} and {{AutoSecurityGroupId}} values, drop the {{admin}} and {{FULLADMIN}} fallbacks in {{AbstractOFBizAuthenticationHandler}}, and add no security group when none is configured.
* Update {{SingleSignOn.adoc}} to tell deployers to configure a least-privilege security group and to note that directory users are matched to OFBiz user logins by username.

This applies to release24.09 only; the ldap plugin was removed from trunk in OFBIZ-13823.

summary: Tomcat clustering fails to start on trunk because the default replication-mode class no longer exists
description:
{{CatalinaContainer}} and the commented cluster sample in {{framework/catalina/ofbiz-component.xml}} use {{org.apache.catalina.tribes.transport.bio.PooledMultiSender}} as the replication-mode, but the Tomcat 11 tribes jar no longer contains the {{transport.bio}} package. Enabling clustering as documented therefore stops OFBiz at startup with "Cluster configuration requires a valid replication-mode property". The sample also sets {{mcast-bind-addr}} to 192.168.2.1, which makes the cluster fail to start on any machine without that address.

The fix uses {{org.apache.catalina.tribes.transport.nio.PooledParallelSender}} as the default and in the sample, and removes the bind address from the sample. Clustering is off by default. release24.09 is not affected because it uses Tomcat 9, which still provides the bio sender.

summary: Remove the JMS service engine
description:
The JMS service engine lets services be sent to a JMS topic or queue through JNDI. In the framework it is used only by distributedClearCacheLineByCondition and the testJMSQueue/testJMSTopic test services, and its default configuration points at an OpenJMS server that OFBiz does not ship. Nobody came forward to use or maintain it in the [retirement thread|https://lists.apache.org/thread/gsdtr4s6ry2g6v87k8t8xbjlvwhpyg73], so it can go. The DistributedCacheClear interface and the distributed-cache-clear-* delegator settings stay, so a cluster cache invalidation implementation can plug in later.

h3. Service engine
* Remove the {{org.apache.ofbiz.service.jms}} package ({{JmsServiceEngine}}, the listeners, {{JmsListenerFactory}} and {{JmsSerializer}}), the {{jms}} engine and {{serviceMessenger}} {{<jms-service>}} in {{serviceengine.xml}}, the {{<jms-service>}} element from {{service-config.xsd}} and its {{JmsService}} config model.
* Remove {{LocalDispatcher.getJMSListeneFactory}}, {{ServiceDispatcher.getJMSListenerFactory}} and {{ServiceDispatcher.enableJMS}}, the {{enableJMS}} property in {{service.properties}} and the OpenJMS entry in {{jndiservers.xml}}.
* Drop the {{geronimo-jms_1.1_spec}} dependency.

h3. Services
* Remove the {{distributedClear*}} services ({{distributedClearAllEntityCaches}}, {{distributedClearCacheLineByValue}}, {{...ByDummyPK}}, {{...ByPrimaryKey}} and {{...ByCondition}}), which only worked through the {{jms}} engine; their HTTP group alternative

last_comment.author: Mridul Pathak
last_comment.text: The removal and its revert are both merged, so trunk is back to the original state. This ticket stays open for the removal itself, which is planned for the stable branch after 26.11, once the new cache invalidation mechanism has shipped alongside JMS. The deprecation for 26.11 will be done in its own ticket after the new mechanism is in place.

summary: SecuredUpload rejects some allowed audio and video formats because their detected MIME types are missing
description:
{{SecuredUpload.isValidAudioFile}} and {{isValidVideoFile}} compare the type returned by Tika's {{detect()}} with a fixed list, but for some extensions allowed by {{allowedExtensionsAudio}} and {{allowedExtensionsVideo}} that list does not contain the type Tika actually returns: .wav is detected as {{audio/vnd.wave}}, .aac as {{audio/x-aac}}, .avi as {{video/x-msvideo}}, .mkv as {{video/x-matroska}} and .webm as {{video/webm}}. These files are therefore rejected, including by content uploads which check them with the "All" type.

The fix adds these types to the lists. This applies to trunk and release24.09, which have the same lists and get the same detection results from Tika 4.2.0 and 3.3.3.

summary: Remove the myportal plugin
description:
The myportal plugin provided a self-service portal webapp for employees and customers. Nobody came forward to use or maintain it in the [retirement thread|https://lists.apache.org/thread/gsdtr4s6ry2g6v87k8t8xbjlvwhpyg73], and OFBIZ-13825 removed the core's dependencies on it, so it can now go. Portal pages, the portlets each application defines and the PORTALPAGE_ADMIN permission stay in the framework.

h3. Plugins
* Remove the {{myportal}} plugin: the {{/myportal}} webapp with its login and registration pages, the {{portalPermissionIsEmployee}} and {{portalPermissionIsCustomer}} services, and its seed and demo data (the {{MYPORTAL*}} permissions, security groups, demo users' groups and portal pages).
* ecommerce's customer registration uses {{MyPortalCaptchaMissingError}} from {{MyPortalUiLabels}}; move that label into the ecommerce labels.
* Remove the myportal chapter from {{plugins-user-manual.adoc}}.

h3. Framework
* Remove the unused {{MyPortal}} label from {{CommonUiLabels.xml}}, the {{MYPORTAL_*}} portal page names from {{CommonPortalEntityLabels.xml}} and the {{MYPORTAL*}} permission and group descriptions from {{SecurityEntityLabels.xml}}.
* Update the help text and demo data comment that mention myportal.

The plugin has no entities. Its permissions, security groups and portal pages stay in databases that loaded them.

summary: Remove the firstdatapaymentgateway plugin
description:
The firstdatapaymentgateway plugin integrates the First Data credit card gateway. Nobody came forward to use or maintain it in the [retirement thread|https://lists.apache.org/thread/gsdtr4s6ry2g6v87k8t8xbjlvwhpyg73], and nothing in the framework or the other plugins depends on it, so it can go. The payment gateway extension points it plugs into (PaymentGatewayConfig, the credit card CustomMethod types and the ccAuth/ccCapture/ccRelease/ccRefund service interfaces) stay in the core.

h3. Plugins
* Remove the {{firstdatapaymentgateway}} plugin: the {{PaymentGatewayFirstData}} entity, the {{/firstdata}} webapp, the {{firstDataCC*}} and {{*PaymentGatewayFirstData}} services, and its seed and demo data (the {{PAY_GATWY_FIRSTDATA}} gateway config type, the {{CC_AUTH_FD}}, {{CC_CAPTURE_FD}}, {{CC_RELEASE_FD}} and {{CC_REFUND_FD}} custom methods, the {{FDSECURITY_*}} permissions and the {{firstdata}} system properties).

The {{PaymentGatewayFirstData}} table is not dropped and holds gateway credentials, so delete its rows or drop it once you no longer need them. A product store whose payment settings use the {{CC_*_FD}} custom methods or a {{PAY_GATWY_FIRSTDATA}} gateway config must switch to another gateway before upgrading.

description:
Several parts of the framework and applications depend on the myportal plugin, so they break or degrade when it is not deployed. This removes those dependencies, as the first step towards retiring myportal (see the [retirement thread|https://lists.apache.org/thread/gsdtr4s6ry2g6v87k8t8xbjlvwhpyg73]). Portal pages and the portlets each application defines are not affected.

h3. Dependencies

* *Portlet permission services:* nine portlets (accounting 2, humanres 2, order 5) set {{securityServiceName}} to {{portalPermissionIsEmployee}} or {{portalPermissionIsCustomer}}, which only myportal defines, together with the {{MYPORTAL_EMPLOYEE}} and {{MYPORTAL_CUSTOMER}} permissions they check. Without myportal, {{ListPortalPortlets.groovy}} fails when it calls the missing service, so the list of portlets to add to a portal page cannot be shown.
* *Portlet reordering:* {{common-theme/js/plugins/myportal.js}} posts to {{/myportal/control/updatePortalPagePortletSeqAjax}}, although the request is defined in the framework's {{portal-controller.xml}}. Reordering portlets in the sfa, catalog, webtools or example portal pages therefore only works when myportal is deployed. It should post to the current webapp.
* *Order emails:* the create, completed and added-note customer request notifications link to {{/myportal/control/showPortletMainDecorator}}. They should link to the request view in the webapp of the store's web site.
* *Labels:* order forms and screens use eleven {{MyPortal*}} la

summary: Remove the pricat plugin
description: The pricat plugin is a scaffold for importing price catalogs from Excel: its only parser is a sample that records import history and never creates products or prices. Its upload was broken from 2021 until 2026 (OFBIZ-12325) without anyone noticing. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes the plugin from trunk with the configuration entries that refer to its classes.

last_comment.text: Follow-up: [#2619|https://github.com/apache/ofbiz-framework/pull/2619] removed the FreeMarker allow-list entries for {{HtmlReport}} and {{SampleHtmlReport}} and the SpotBugs exclusion for {{AbstractReportThread}}, all of which pointed at htmlreport classes deleted with this removal. It is merged in trunk as a64405b228.

summary: Remove remote EntitySync
description: Remote EntitySync (pushing or pulling data to another OFBiz instance) can no longer run on trunk: it relied on the HTTP service engine, removed in 2026, or on RMI, disabled since 2016, and its manual already says it is no longer available out of the box. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes the remote services and code. Offline EntitySync, the EntitySync entities and the cleanup job stay.

The offline flow cannot complete a sync on trunk, and moving data between instances is covered by the webtools XML export and import.

summary: Remove the workeffort iCalendar servlet
description: The iCalendar servlet publishes work efforts as .ics files over WebDAV. It never supported CalDAV, and since the ControlFilter change in 2016 only the demo calendar can be reached (OFBIZ-10595). It also needs an outdated ical4j build from an extra Maven repository. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes the servlet, its WebDAV support, the WorkEffortIcalData entity and the dependency from trunk.

summary: Remove the scrum plugin
description: The scrum plugin was donated in 2011 and its donor stopped contributing the same year. Its last functional change was in 2020, the Subversion integration that set it apart has not worked since 2021, and its demo page shows an error on the public demo server. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes it from trunk. Its extra CustRequest and TimeEntry columns and its data stay in existing databases.

summary: Remove SOAP and RMI support
description: SOAP has been disabled since OFBIZ-12212 (2021) and RMI since OFBIZ-6942 (2016), but their engines, handlers, WSDL generation, keystores and dependencies are still shipped and maintained. Following the dev@ discussions on retiring SOAP and on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes both from trunk. Integrations should use the REST API.

summary: Remove the ldap plugin
description:
The ldap plugin provides CAS, LDAP and Active Directory login handlers, but it only works if each webapp's login requests are edited by hand, nothing in OFBiz does that, and it has received only maintenance changes for years. Its CAS client ({{cas-server-support-ldap-core}}) also brings a large Spring dependency tree onto the shared classpath. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes it from trunk.

LDAP login remains available through the framework ({{security.ldap.enable}}); single sign-on is part of a separate OpenID Connect proposal. Release branch: trunk only, release24.09 keeps the plugin.

summary: Remove the cmssite plugin
description: The cmssite plugin is a 2007 demo front-end for the content component's CMS, with a multi-site filter added in 2016-17 (OFBIZ-7120). Its demo pages are FreeMarker templates stored in the database, which the content component no longer renders, and nothing cmssite-specific has changed since 2017. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes the plugin from trunk with the core multi-site handling only it enabled.

summary: Implement Native TOTP Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
description:
This issue implements native *Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)* using standard *RFC 6238 Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP)* in Apache OFBiz.

*Key implementation highlights:*
* Native TOTP enrollment and challenge verification compatible with Google, Microsoft, and 2FAS authenticators.
* In-memory SVG Data URI generation for QR codes with zero external network or CDN dependencies.
* Strict session isolation, preventing unauthenticated sessions or history records until MFA succeeds.
* Security controls including OTP replay prevention (time-step tracking), challenge expiry, and lockout protection.
* Staged 2-step challenge handshake for REST API token minting (/rest/auth/token) issuing RFC 8176 assurance claims.
* Native UI integration across Backoffice themes and B2C eCommerce storefront (plugins/ecommerce).
* Fully backward compatible and opt-in by default (security.login.authFactor.enable=false).

  
*Detailed architecture, security design, and verification proposal document:*

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ugqe8Z5vm2Ikkr55o2eDlYbjpvszVbuuEK8P-e-tzYw/edit?usp=sharing

summary: Enhance JWT Token to trust other issuers and handle sub(ject) instead of userLoginId
description:
JWT Token enforces claim `iss`(uer) to be `ApacheOfBiz` - I would like to be able to add a different trusted issuer.

Also, meanwhile claim `sub` is widely used to identify the subject being authenticated, i.e. the userLoginId. OfBiz should at least handle sub as this claim is also specified by RFC 7519.

last_comment.author: Carsten Schinzer
last_comment.text:
I can also shed some light here, [~lfinster] and [~jacopoc] :

While your instinct, Lukas, is good we have to be careful to not mix two architectural layers. Here's the breakdown:

*Where each concept comes from*
 * {{aud}} is a *registered JWT claim* (RFC 7519 §4.1.3): _who the token is intended for_ — the recipient/destination. The RFC even mandates rejection if the processing party doesn't find itself in {{{}aud{}}}. ([ RFC 7519|https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519])
 * {{scope}} is *not a JWT claim at all* — it's an OAuth 2.0 _authorization-framework_ parameter (RFC 6749 §3.

description: The passport plugin offers GitHub and LinkedIn login, but it is not wired into any login page (the ecommerce includes have been commented out since 2015), its LinkedIn login uses an API LinkedIn has retired, and it has had no feature work since 2017. description: The datafile component reads and writes fixed-width and delimited files from XML definitions. description: The multiflex plugin is an alternative ecommerce theme that no demo store uses; its last real work was in 2019, and a 2020 fix corrected a stylesheet path that had been wrong for about 13 months. Nothing in OFBiz triggers it: the core {{sendTelecomMessage}} service it plugs into has no caller, and the plugin has had no functional change since 2019 (OFBIZ-10973 has been open since then). Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes the plugin from trunk; the core telecom services stay as an extension point.

description: The Clojure service engine (OFBIZ-12302, 2021) is used only by an echo service and a test service, has no users in applications or plugins, and has only received dependency bumps since it was added. Following the dev@ discussion on retiring experimental and abandoned features, this removes the engine, its sample services and test, the Clojure dependency and the clojars repository from trunk. Projects with their own Clojure services can keep the engine class in a plugin.

summary: Remove the disabled BIRT plugin and its leftovers from trunk
description:
The BIRT plugin has been disabled on all maintained branches since OFBIZ-12824 (CVE-2022-25371) and is pinned to BIRT 4.5.0 from 2015. This ticket would remove it from trunk together with the code that depends on it or still mentions it.

* ofbiz-plugins: remove {{birt}}; remove the eight BIRT charts and the chart-only Product Statistics page from {{scrum}}; remove the unused {{CommonBirtDecorator}} stub from {{exampleext}}, the {{/birt}} dependabot entries and the plugins user manual include.
* ofbiz-framework: remove {{BIRT_FLEXIBLE_REPORT_POLICY}} from {{UtilCodec}}, the {{BirtOrderReportsWarning}} label, the order report events and help page that only the BIRT reports used, the Docker default that disables {{plugins/birt}}, the Maven repository that only BIRT needs in {{build.gradle}} and the {{.gitignore}} entry.

summary: Add permission checks to the entity sync services in release24.09
description:
The offline entity sync services {{runOfflineEntitySync}} and {{loadOfflineEntitySyncData}} have no permission check, and their webtools requests only require a login, so any user who can log in to webtools, including the read-only admin group, can run them. {{loadOfflineEntitySyncData}} also accepts any location for its file and stores the values it reads through {{storeEntitySyncData}}, which writes to any entity without checking permissions; {{storeEntitySyncData}} and {{pullAndReportEntitySyncData}} are also exported with only an authentication check.

h3. Proposed fix
Require an entity sync permission in the offline and store services, and limit {{loadOfflineEntitySyncData}} to local files.

h3. Affected branches
release24.09. On trunk these services are removed by OFBIZ-13820.

summary: SecuredUpload.isValidFile throws instead of rejecting a malformed CSV file
description:
When a CSV file is malformed, for instance with an unterminated quote, commons-csv throws an {{UncheckedIOException}} from {{CSVParser.getRecords()}} in {{SecuredUpload.isValidCsvFile}}, which is not caught. {{isValidFile}} then throws instead of returning false, both for the "CSV" type and for the "All" type when a file that fails the other checks contains a stray quote. The upload ends with an unexpected-exception error instead of the supported-formats message, and the rejected file is not deleted because {{deleteBadFile}} is never reached.

The fix catches the parsing exception in {{isValidCsvFile}} and returns false. This applies to trunk and release24.09, which have the same code and the same commons-csv version.
